reply_text:
Bettina, I couldn't set up the Monday digest. The scheduler refused my request: the gateway needs sign-in credentials, and the setup route I tried also failed because the AI service isn't signed in. Nothing is scheduled yet, so no digest will post on Monday 19 October until this is fixed.

Someone with admin access needs to sign the AI service back in (Models in the Control UI, or `openclaw configure`). Then ask me again and I'll create the recurring job: Mondays at 08:00 Chicago time, starting 19 October, posting here from #coastal-team and #coastal-random.

When it runs, the digest will cover the previous week's messages from both channels, plus open customer items taken only from those two channels. It won't include finance figures such as rates, prices, discounts, contract values, invoice amounts or payment terms, and it won't include anything from direct messages.
